_comment: BAND-SPLIT. Band-local clusters for band2_stone_and_root. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. Existing entries keep the index they had before the split because the merged array order is the order props are added to the scene tree, and Godot silently auto-renames same-named siblings by that order. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 2000-2999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.

clusters.name: quarry_station
clusters._why: SD16, and the cluster EV7-remainder listed as still unbuilt and left to this item. The Old Quarry's own working face, abandoned mid-shift: the gear a crew leaves when the work stops rather than when it finishes. It sits on the quarry floor between the two foundations and the conduit head, so the walk in reads working face -> old foundations -> Team Tether hardware, which is the order §32's reveal ladder wants that rung told in. Every model is one the settlement already uses (D24, one prop family); nothing here is new.

props._why: the cluster's anchor -- a crate of cut stone still standing where it was filled
set against the first crate's side, not merely near it -- EV7-clusters-fix's own finding: a loose arc of props reads as dumped, a touching pile reads as one load
water for the crew, kept with the load
leaning where it was set down, pitched off vertical against the rock -- the one prop in the cluster that names the work, and the reason the player's own pickaxe is the tool the rootstone wants
tipped over a couple of paces off the pile, so the group has an edge instead of a boundary
somebody's pack, still here -- the detail that makes the site abandoned rather than merely disused

clusters.name: ranger_camp
clusters._why: MQ2B, docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 5 camp table: 'a ring of stones, a collapsed lean-to, and someone's kit. Salvage, not shelter' -- the ranger_camp_spur loop's own destination (terrain_playground.json trail.loops, leaves the spine at [-150,2210], rejoins at [-310,2320]), authored bare until now. Placed a few metres off the loop's own painted road, at its midpoint, so the road passes beside the camp rather than through it -- something you notice on the spur, not something you walk over. NOTE ON SUBSTITUTION: the shipped prop family (assets/props/quaternius_fantasy, the only pack props.gd's loader reads) has no stone or tent/frame mesh, so the fire ring and lean-to described above are read through what the family actually has -- a toppled cot standing in for the collapsed shelter, an open cabinet for the ring of stones' absence, same reasoning old_quarry.gd's own cluster already leans on for 'somebody's pack, still here'. D24's one-prop-family rule holds: nothing here is new.

props._why: the shelter's own collapse -- the cot pitched over rather than standing, the cluster's anchor
toppled beside the cot, door-side down -- whatever it held is long gone or scattered
supply crate, emptied out -- nobody restocked it before leaving
someone's kit, still here -- the same detail that makes the quarry site read abandoned rather than merely disused, told again in a different place
tipped a couple of paces from the cot, dry long before the camp was left
a ranger's own tool, set down and never picked back up
what lashed the lean-to together, come loose with it
